about: The listing of packs: every pack an owner can pick on the install page. Each entry names its pack file in its author's own repository, at one commit, with the file's SHA-256: nothing of a pack is copied into this repository, but base.pack, which lies beside the install page (builder/base.pack) and goes onto every unit the page installs. ours names the repositories of open-field's own packs: the install page shows its warning on every pack that is not in one of them. A pack gets in by a pull request that changes only this file; tools/catalog_check.py checks it, and the maintainer reviews it. docs/catalog.md says how.
